captions.detailed: These marine waterproof binoculars feature a sturdy dark-colored chassis consisting of two heavy cylindrical objective housings. The housings are securely mounted parallel to each other on a fixed central bridge. Located on the bridge is a large, ribbed central focus knob that rotates continuously. One of the rear eyepieces is equipped with a diopter adjustment ring that also rotates continuously for fine-tuning focus.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of marine waterproof binoculars. The model should include two cylindrical objective lens housings fixed to a central bridge, a large central focus wheel that rotates continuously, and a diopter adjustment ring on one of the eyepieces that also rotates continuously.
captions.factory: Construct the main chassis using a combination of cylinder and box primitives to form the parallel objective barrels and the connecting central bridge. Create the central focus wheel as a cylinder with a ribbed texture or small pattern and define a continuous articulation joint for its rotation. Model the eyepieces using smaller cylinders, adding a separate cylindrical collar on one eyepiece to represent the diopter adjustment ring, defined with its own continuous rotational joint.
